ai_summary: Agro Phos (India) Limited has received new credit ratings, with its long-term facilities of Rs. 33.25 Cr rated "ACUITE BBB-" (Stable) and short-term facilities of Rs. 18.50 Cr rated "ACUITE A3." The "BBB-" long-term rating places the company at the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum, indicating a moderate credit risk profile that could impact future borrowing costs. A key red flag is the anomalous future date of "08th September, 2026" for the rating assignment, suggesting a potential error in the document's dating.
